limits: Describes what the importer read from each file; a file it could not read is listed with its reason, not described.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Describes the project's files as the copilot is told about them; computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: What files does this project hold, what does each carry, and which tool reads it?

description: Describe the project the way the copilot is told about it: every file, what it carries and which tool reads it, which files are indexed or paired with each other, and the codon-usage tables a tool resolves by name. Over the API or MCP it describes the files sent as _files; in the app it describes the open project.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

title.description: the project's name, for the header line when the files were sent with the call. In the app the open project's own title is used.

name: describe_project

text.description: the project section exactly as the copilot receives it, one line per fact

unread.description: files sent with the call that the importer could not read, each with its reason. They are not in the project, exactly as a file the app refuses at import is not
